headline: Student Union Replaces Protest Banners With 'Polite Suggestions' Printed On Gourmet Biscuits
body: Following the withdrawal of restrictions on campus demonstrations, student activists have pivoted to edible activism by delivering requests for administrative reform via custom-stamped, artisanal digestive cookies.
caption: The path to reform is now paved with snacks. Will a ginger snap finally get the library open past midnight? #StudentLife #CampusHumour #BiscuitDiplomacy (satire)
igHook: Would you trade your protest signs for a box of cookies if it meant getting your demands met faster?
imagePrompt: A close-up shot of a tray of round, plain biscuits sitting on a wooden table, each stamped with simple, polite text in food-grade ink.

sourceHeadline.title: In U-Turn, Vijay Government Withdraws Order Barring Students From Protesting

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 7 wins by successfully deploying a specific, tactile, and whimsical image (stamped artisanal biscuits) as a form of protest, which avoids the repetitive 'vibe check' or 'meditation' tropes found in other submissions. It maintains a light, affectionate tone that feels grounded and genuinely humorous without relying on cynical institutional critique.

safetyVerdict.reasoning: The article is a harmless satirical piece about student activism and makes no mention of real private or public figures. It avoids all prohibited categories such as communal, religious, or ethnic targeting, and the image prompt is generic.
